Otherwise, it was considered sheltered or "sometimes." "Sometimes" refers to sites with more than 20 km of fetch through a narrow geographic window and therefore potentially exposed during cyclone seasons.

Kd490 with a 100-km buffer. Turbidity is positively related to the diffuse attenuation coefficient of light at the 490 nm wavelength (Kd490), or the rate at which light at 490 nm is attenuated with depth. A Kd490 value of 0.1 m⁻¹ means that light intensity is reduced by one natural-log value within 10 m of water. Higher Kd490 values represent higher attenuation and higher turbidity.
